intro: Clip Courier finds recent Twitch clips through Streamer.bot and publishes each stable clip once to a private Discord webhook. It never reads arbitrary local clip files.

sections.title: 1. Quick setup
sections.notice: Import the Clip Courier package, put the webhook only in its Deliver action, Save and Compile, approve Get Clips and Deliver, then enable.

sections.title: 5. Safety and privacy
sections.notice: Only bounded public clip metadata and delivery IDs are retained. The webhook remains inside Streamer.bot and Discord mentions are disabled.
